breakdown.notes: Denmark is Europe's largest pork exporter. 62% of land is agricultural.

steps.name: Sjømat
steps.notes: Denmark functions as a Nordic and EU seafood processing and trade hub. Hirtshals and Skagen are key logistics nodes; Danish processors import raw material from Norway, Iceland, Greenland and the Faroe Islands for EU-market processing and re-export.
steps.method_note: Backfilled from local Nordic value-chain notes and normalized fish/seafood trade CSV to close structural 8/8 coverage. Use as a research placeholder until Danish fisheries/trade sources and company reports are primary-checked.

steps.notes: Salling Group and Coop DK dominate distribution.

steps.name: Detaljhandel
steps.format_notes: Discount >40% of market. Netto (Salling) is largest chain.

steps.name: HoReCa
steps.notes: Copenhagen municipality: 87.7% of municipal food purchases were organic in 2024, versus 88% in 2015. The 2024 figure uses procurement data, while 2015 used an older mixed measurement basis; this is neither a method-identical trend nor a national Danish share.

steps.name: Avfall/sirkularitet
